ASSESSMENT

Diagnosis: Congestive heart failure in an old beagle. Pulmonary crackles consistent with fluid overload or pulmonary oedema.

Differential Diagnosis: Other causes of pulmonary crackles could include pneumonia or pulmonary fibrosis, but given the heart failure history and response to diuretics, congestive heart failure is most likely.

PLAN

Treatment Plan and Recommendations: Furosemide increased to 40mg PO twice daily. Enalapril continued at 10mg once daily. Monitor resting respiratory rate at home and recheck next week. 

Follow-up: Recheck resting respiratory rate next week.
